corrections.text: The article states that "a 4K image consumes 3780 tokens" on Nano Banana 2.1 and that the 4K per-image price therefore falls by a smaller margin than the per-token rate. That figure is from Google's pricing page, which lists $0.113 per 4K image. The image generation guide, also cited by the article, lists 2520 tokens for a 4K image on Nano Banana 2.1 across its aspect ratios, the same count as on Nano Banana 2. The two Google pages disagree, and the article does not say so; if the guide's count applies, the 4K reduction would match the per-token cut.
